name: peek-card-keeps-a-placeholder-while-the-page-loads
description:
A popup adopted as a peek card used to drop its loading placeholder the moment it was adopted, and every target=_blank link off a favourite takes that path now. Until the page painted, the card was a see-through window over the dimmed page: the user saw the scrim darken and nothing else for as long as the page took. The card now keeps its placeholder (the overlay paper colour and a throbber) until the popup's first paint.

The opener is a solid red page that window.opens a non-routable address, so the popup connects forever and never paints. The measurement is a pixel mean inside the card, away from its centre so the throbber does not land in it: with the bug the region is the dimmed red opener (about 166,0,0), with the fix it is the paper. 'Atrium: peek first paint' must be absent, or the region is a painted page and not the placeholder.

The click lands at 300,620 for the reason popup-opens-as-a-peek gives: the screen recording's consent dialog floats over the middle of the window. The card region is read off that scenario's own after frame: the card spans about x 327-925 at 280px of sidebar.

actions.note: gate: the opener page really committed as the startup tab
let the page paint and the sidebar settle
the red opener, no card yet
THE MEASUREMENT, first way in: the button opens the popup
second way in, a no-op when the click landed
